name: Dominik Žabčík
about: Engineer and CISO at NFCtron in Prague. I build payment software and keep it hard to break.
headline: Full-stack TypeScript engineer, CISO and Head of Development
profile: Backend-first TypeScript engineer who leads development and security at NFCtron, a payment platform for live events. Since 2023 I have merged 649 pull requests there, from payments and ticketing to a native Android point of sale. I work mostly in Node.js and NestJS, reach for React and Next.js when a product needs a face, and build my own products in Swift and on Cloudflare.

experience.title: CISO and Head of Development
experience.summary: I run engineering and own the security of the payment platform.
highlights: Own security, risk, incident response and every PCI and card scheme certification; led PCI DSS 4.0.1 and PCI MPoC.
Build a native Android point of sale in Kotlin and the attendee app in React Native.
Roll out AI agents: an internal Slack agent and shared tooling for coding agents.

experience.title: Core Backend Developer Lead
experience.summary: I led the core backend team and owned the architecture of its services.
highlights: Led the core backend developers: planning, code review and mentoring.
Owned the design of core services built on NestJS, PostgreSQL, Redis and RabbitMQ.
Kept production running on Kubernetes and Docker, with search on Typesense.

experience.title: Core Backend Developer
experience.summary: I joined to build the backend that payments at live events run on.
highlights: Built and shipped core backend services in TypeScript on NestJS.
Worked across PostgreSQL, Redis, RabbitMQ and Typesense in production.
Moved up to team lead after sixteen months.
